claims: The 98th Academy Awards were held on March 15, 2026.
A tie occurred in the Best Live Action Short Film category at the 98th Academy Awards.
The tie was between The Singers (Sam A. Davis and Jack Piatt) and Two People Exchanging Saliva (Alexandre Singh and Natalie Musteata).
The Best Live Action Short Film tie at the 98th Academy Awards marks the seventh tie in Oscar history.
The Best Live Action Short Film tie at the 98th Academy Awards is the first Oscar tie since 2013.
Kumail Nanjiani presented the Best Live Action Short Film tie at the 98th Academy Awards.

Kumail Nanjiani announced the Best Live Action Short Film tie at the 98th Academy Awards, jokingly stating, "It's a tie. I'm not joking. It's actually a tie. So everyone, calm down, we're going to get through this".
The Best Live Action Short Film tie at the 98th Academy Awards is the first tie in that category since 1995.
There was an Oscar tie in 2013 in the Sound Editing category between Skyfall and Zero Dark Thirty.
There was an Oscar tie in 1995 in the Live Action Short category between Franz Kafka's It's a Wonderful Life and Trevor.
There was an Oscar tie in 1987 in the Documentary Feature category between Artie Shaw: Time Is All You've Got and Down and Out in America.
There was an Oscar tie in 1969 in the Best Actress category between Katharine Hepburn (The Lion in Winter) and Barbra Streisand (Funny Girl).
There was an Oscar tie in 1950 in the Documentary Short category between A Chance to Live and So Much for So Little.
There was an Oscar tie in 1932 in the Best Actor category between Fredric March (Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde) and Wallace Beery (The Champ).
